subject: Kickoff: DIPPER red-teaming for the provenance features
body:
Santiago, team,

Kicking off the DIPPER track. Context: the provenance features we are committing to customers claim to identify AI-generated text. DIPPER exists to break exactly those claims -- it is an 11B paraphrase model with scalar knobs for lexical diversity and reordering, and paraphrasing detector inputs with it demolishes current detectors; the published result drops DetectGPT from 70.3% detection accuracy to 4.6% at a 1% false positive rate.

So the plan is honest red-teaming: run DIPPER against our own detection stack, measure what survives, and evaluate the paper's retrieval-based defense (searching a database of prior generations) as the mitigation we would actually ship.

Milestones: attack results June 12, defense evaluation July 17, recommendation to the provenance leads by July 31.

Priya
